detail.title: 32CH 1U 2HDDs WizSense Network Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite NVR4232-EI 32CH 1U 2HDDs WizSense Network Video Recorder Key Points • Max. 256/256/256 Mbps Incoming/Recording/Outgoing Bandwidth • Max. Decoding Capability: 16 × 1080p@30 fps • IP Cameras Resolution Up to 16 MP • 2 Bays. Each HDD Storage Capacity Up to 20TB • AI by Recorder: 1-ch Face Detection and Recognition, 4-ch SMD, 2-ch Perimeter Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.AI by Recorder: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; and SMD
General.AI by Camera: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD; ANPR; people counting; stereo analysis; heat map
General.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel
General.Face Attributes: Gender; age group; glasses; expressions; face mask; beard
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 1 channel (up to 12 face images/s each channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 20,000 images, with a total capacity of 2.5 G. Name, gender, birthday, address, credential type, credential No., countries & regions and state can be added to each face image.
General.Face Recognition Performance of AI by Re: 8-channel FD (by camera) + FR (by recorder),image stream: 12 face images/s 1-channel FD (by recorder) + FR (by recorder), video stream: 12 face images/s
General.SMD Plus by Recorder: 4 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 256 Mbps incoming, 256 Mbps recording and 256 Mbps outgoing AI enabled: 180 Mbps incoming, 180 Mbps recording and 180 Mbps outgoing
General.Resolution: 16 MP;12 MP;8 MP;6 MP;5 MP;4 MP;3 MP;1080p;720p;960p;D1;CIF
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2-channel 16 MP@30 fps; 2-channel 12 MP@30 fps; 4-channel 8 MP@30 fps; 4-channel 6 MP@30 fps; 6-channel 5 MP@30 fps; 8-channel 4 MP@30 fps; 16-channel 1080p@30 fps; 32-channel 720p@30 fps AI enabled: 1-channel 16 MP@30 fps; 2-channel 12 MP@30 fps; 3-channel 8 MP@30 fps; 3-channel 6 MP@30 fps; 4-channel 5 MP@30 fps; 6-channel 4 MP@30 fps; 12-channel 1080p@30 fps; 16-channel 720p@30 fps; 32-channel D1@30 fps
General.Video Output: 1 HDMI, 1 VGA HDMI: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Simultaneous/heterogeneous video sources output for VGA and HDMI is configurable.
General.Third-party Camera Access: Panasonic, Sony, Hanwha, Axis, Pelco, Arecont, ONVIF, Canon
General.Video Compression: Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264; MJPEG
General.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UPnP; SNMP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; IP Filter; PPPoE; DDNS; FTP; Alarm Server; IP Search (Support Dahua IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.); P2P; Auto Registration
General.Interoperability: ONVIF 23.12(Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, tag playback, smart playback
General.General Alarm: Motion detection; privacy masking; video loss; scene changing; PIR alarm; IPC external alarm
General.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk; disk error; low space; low quota space; abnormal disk health; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline; audio detection
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus; people counting; stereo analysis; heat map
General.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot; IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log; preset; email
General.Disk Interface: 2 SATA ports, up to 20 TB.The maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature.
General.USB: 2 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 2.0 port)
